* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Garrison Klint DS 1998 Juneau.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Klint asked the list for cuts that would fit Monnok or Failure At The Cave.

== Strategy ==

The first eight cards set the opening: troopers with Elis Helrot, or walkers with pilots. Stunning Leader covers fights inside Echo Base. Walker Garrison is the drain theme.
